summary: Backend regression suite (33 pytest cases) + frontend smoke: auth, dashboard, POS scan, all sidebar routes. Backend TESTS A/B/C/D/E all PASS. Two CRITICAL bugs found: (1) demo users (@demo.local) can't login (Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLD -> 422), breaking every demo button on /login; (2) /ordini and /sistema/sincronizzazioni routes crash to a fully blank page because Orders.jsx and SyncLog use `useEffect(async () => ...)` which returns a Promise and throws 'destroy is not a function', unmounting the whole layout.

critical.issue: Login with any *@demo.local user returns 422 'The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email' because LoginIn.email uses Pydantic EmailStr. Blocks all 4 demo users (manager/cassa.donna1/cassa.donna2/cassa.uomo). Fix: change LoginIn.email to `str` (email format is not required for a login lookup) OR relax email-validator by using `EmailStr` with `email_validator` in test mode / switch demo TLD to a valid one (e.g. @demo.test won't work either; @example.com works).

minor.issue: Endpoint uses `Depends(get_current_user_dep)` — a real Shopify webhook cannot send a JWT/cookie. For a production webhook this must use HMAC verification instead of session auth. Currently acceptable as a simulate endpoint but flag for future.
SKU uniqueness is checked inside the loop AFTER product is already inserted; on error the parent product remains orphaned (no transaction). Consider validating all SKUs upfront.

`allow_origins=['*']` combined with `allow_credentials=True` is invalid per CORS spec. Browsers currently work only because cookies aren't strictly required (Bearer fallback exists). Set explicit origin from FRONTEND_URL env.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking any demo user button (Cassa Donna 1/2, Cassa Uomo, Manager DEMO) auto-fills the form and submits, but backend returns 422 due to .local TLD validation. User sees no visible error toast, just stays on /login. Users can NOT use any demo account. Once backend LoginIn.email is loosened this works.

Route renders a completely BLANK page. Root cause: `useEffect(async () => { ... })` inside Orders.jsx returns a Promise; React tries to call it as cleanup -> 'destroy is not a function' -> component throws -> since there is no ErrorBoundary the whole Protected layout unmounts (no sidebar either). Fix pattern: `useEffect(() => { const run = async () => {...}; run(); }, [])`.
Same async useEffect bug; page renders empty (0 chars body).

integration_issues.issue: Demo button click -> POST /api/auth/login 422 -> silently kept on /login (no toast). Add error surface AND fix backend validation.

issues: No visible error message when login fails (422/401). Silent failure confuses non-technical users.
Missing top-level ErrorBoundary — a bug in any single page unmounts the whole app shell (sidebar + header).

action_items: Fix backend LoginIn.email validation (use `str` instead of EmailStr, or accept reserved TLDs). Without this, ALL demo accounts are unusable.
Fix Orders.jsx and SyncLog useEffect: don't pass an async function directly to useEffect.
Add a global ErrorBoundary around Protected routes so a broken page doesn't blank the whole shell.
Show a toast/inline error on Login when /api/auth/login returns non-200 (currently silent).
Tighten CORS: replace allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True with explicit FRONTEND_URL origin.
Consider transactional rollback / upfront SKU validation in POST /api/products.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 830+ lines: split into routers per domain (auth, catalog, inventory, pos, shopify, csv, admin) as already hinted by empty /app/backend/routers dir.
auth_utils.get_current_user_dep also raises 401 on any decode exception generically; consider narrower catch to preserve stack traces.
seed_admin_and_demo_users updates admin password if changed, but never resets demo users' passwords if broken — acceptable for MVP.
Shopify webhook auth: use HMAC signature verification instead of user JWT (production-blocker for real integration).
shopify_webhook_order writes external_id both on sales and inventory_movements with suffix `:{loc.code}` — good for idempotency across locations.

Two known failures reflect real bugs (demo login + user creation flow that depends on demo login). After the main agent fixes LoginIn.email validation, re-run the same suite; then retest /ordini + /sistema/sincronizzazioni after the async useEffect fix (should render sale orders table and sync jobs table respectively). demo_login_422.reproduce: curl -s -X POST $BACKEND/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"cassa.donna1@demo.local","password":"Demo123!"}' -> HTTP 422 with detail 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name'.
demo_login_422.root_cause: models.py LoginIn.email is pydantic EmailStr, which under email-validator>=2 rejects reserved TLDs like .local, .test, .example, .invalid.
demo_login_422.mitigation: Change `email: EmailStr` -> `email: str` in LoginIn (login lookup does not need RFC-strict validation).

blank_pages_ordini_sync.reproduce: Login as admin, navigate to /ordini or /sistema/sincronizzazioni -> whole page (including sidebar) is white.
blank_pages_ordini_sync.root_cause: useEffect callback is declared `async () => { ... }` returning a Promise; React then calls the returned value as cleanup, throwing 'destroy is not a function'. Without an ErrorBoundary the whole ProtectedLayout unmounts.
blank_pages_ordini_sync.mitigation: In Orders.jsx and SyncLog (OtherPages.jsx), replace `useEffect(async () => {...}, [])` with `useEffect(() => { (async () => { ... })(); }, [])` and add a global ErrorBoundary in App.js.
